[NDET.3.2] `ds_version` is the DS version that wrote the stream, and it is the
only version a stream carries ([LDET.1.10]). A reader accepts a stream whose
`ds_version` begins with its own `<major>.<minor>.` and refuses every other with
`DS_ERR_FS_VERSION`. An
integrator comparing the field for anything other than that prefix is asserting
a guarantee DS does not make.

`dsc_hash` is `NULL` with length `0` until a DSC has been loaded; afterward it is
the 32-byte hash of that artefact — pair it with the platform signature to assert
"this recording was made against this rule set on this platform." Pointers are
engine-lifetime; copy before `ds_engine_free`.
